stem: The masses, in kilograms, of cartons of sugar and cartons of flour have the distributions $\text{N}(78.8, 12.6^2)$ and $\text{N}(62.0, 10.0^2)$ respectively.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: The standard load for a certain crane is 8 cartons of sugar and 3 cartons of flour. The maximum load that can be carried safely by the crane is 900 kg. Stating a necessary assumption, find the percentage of standard loads that will exceed the maximum safe load.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that a randomly chosen carton of sugar has a smaller mass than a randomly chosen carton of flour.
